_comment: Code suggestions for the build script of the MTEX website. Everything makeDoc understands goes through check_option / get_option, so all inputs are optional and may be given in any order.

inputs.name: section
inputs.purpose: publish only this section - all three if none is given

inputs.name: file
inputs.purpose: publish only pages whose source path contains this pattern; implies force

inputs.name: force
inputs.purpose: republish also pages that are not newer than their html

inputs.name: clear
inputs.purpose: remove all generated pages and reload mtexdata, after asking

inputs.name: checkLinks
inputs.purpose: scan the generated html for dead links once everything is published

inputs.name: keepImages
inputs.purpose: do not revert images that were only re-rendered

inputs.name: skipDirtyImages
inputs.purpose: do not republish pages just because their images are uncommitted

inputs.name: hideFigures
inputs.purpose: publish without the figures showing up on screen
